title: Lumen
summary: An identity for a clinic network that had to feel calm at 3 a.m. and clear on a cracked phone screen.

body.html:
Lumen runs night clinics. Its patients arrive tired, worried and often on old phones with the brightness turned down.

A quieter brand

We built the identity around a slow orbit, the mark breathes, it never blinks, and a type system tested at the smallest size people actually read it.
